    private async getOrLoadPlaybackForEvent(event: MatrixEvent): Promise<Playback | undefined> {
        const eventId = event.getId();

        if (!eventId) {

        if (!this.playbacks.has(eventId)) {

        const playback = this.playbacks.get(eventId);
